title: Which script produces this output?
examObjective: Defining, using, and reusing DataWeave modules, functions, and variables
prompt:
Upper-case every key at every depth. Given the payload below,

**which script produces exactly this output?**

```
{ "A": 1, "B": { "C": [ { "D": 2 } ] } }
```

options:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun rk(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> o mapObject ((val, k) -> { (upper(k)): val })
  case a is Array -> a map rk($)
  else -> v
}
---
rk(payload)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json

  case o is Object -> o mapObject ((val, k) -> { (upper(k)): rk(val) })

---
rk(payload)

explanation.approach: The function has to recurse into Objects and into Arrays, and it has to call itself on each value. Each wrong option drops one of the three: all recursion, the Array case, or the recursive call on values.
